args.name: Search for ripe berries
args.function: Physically search the nearby area for red berry plants and collect available ripe berries from an accessible plant, stopping if none can be found within a bounded search.
args.conditions: I am outdoors at (131.1,16.91), healthy, with 80 satiety, 40 energy and no inventory. Red berries are known to provide 8 nutrition with zero toxicity. The berry plants currently observed have zero stock. Unknown foods must not be eaten. Search must respect obstacles, real distance, actual plant stock and other people's possessions.
args.inputs: Nearby terrain and berry plants encountered through actual travel; no tools are currently owned. Limit the search to a distance and energy budget that leaves a safe reserve, and collect no more than four ripe berries.
args.costs: Travel, observation and harvesting costs are not fully known; specify feasible costs and a bounded search before execution. No creation of food or accelerated growth is requested.
args.effects: Discover reachable berry sources through physical observation and, only if ripe stock is present and collection is feasible, transfer a limited amount of that stock to my inventory. Report an unsuccessful search honestly. Implementation alone does not perform the search or grant mastery.

candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.
